instructions: Copy this template; null fields are missing measurements, never defaults.
Use independently measured task XYZ and original source-image pixels. Do not derive camera anchors from the robot FK being calibrated.
Declare whole calibration captures as fit or verification before fitting; retain reserved policy-evaluation episodes outside both.
Camera fitting needs at least six fit correspondences, preferably distributed in 3D, and separate verification captures.
For joint-zero fitting independently fix the camera and MJCF-world-to-task base registration, then annotate known body-local landmarks at varied measured poses.
Joint order is shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll. q_nominal_rad already contains verified units/signs; the fit estimates added zero offsets only.
gripper_joint_rad is fixed per observation and must be measured/mapped independently, not inferred by the arm fitter.

Wrist mode uses wrist_camera intrinsics and wrist_registration observations to fit a fixed T_optical_link mount. T_task_link must be independently verified and identical for all points in a capture_group.
For wrist link_pose_source=verified_fk, verify arm mapping and base registration first and record their provenance. Do not jointly fit arm geometry and wrist-camera extrinsics.
Report candidates are diagnostic only. Pixel fitting does not substitute for held-out metric object checks or collision-free reference replay.
